# WGS atlas data

  - DM sites between Colon and Antrum or SI and Antrum

```{r}
all_results_beta_annotated_wgs <- readRDS("../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/WGS_gut_DM.rds")

wgs_sig <- lapply(all_results_beta_annotated_wgs, function(x) {
  x <- subset(x, adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 0.2)
  x$direction <- ifelse(x$logFC > 0.2, "hyper", "hypo")
  return(x)
})
```



```{r}
all_hyper_cpg <- list()
all_hypo_cpg <- list()
```


```{r}
load(file.path(result_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_and_EPIC_annotated.RData") )
im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
```

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and FDR < 5% as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp = im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results
n_total_cpgs <- nrow(tmp)

hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

n = "IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_and_EPIC"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg_592_594
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg_592_594
```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 


#### Overlap with WGS atlas gut DM sites


```{r}
all_ovlp_hyper <- list()
all_ovlp_hypo <- list()

ovlp_res_hyper <- list()
ovlp_res_hypo <- list()

for (n in names(wgs_sig)) {
  tmp <- wgs_sig[[n]]
  tmp$comparison_wgs <- n
  all_ovlp_hyper[[n]] <- merge(hyper_cpg_592_594, tmp, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ilmn_id", all.x=T, sort=F)
  all_ovlp_hypo[[n]] <- merge(hypo_cpg_592_594, tmp, by.x="Row.names", by.y="ilmn_id", all.x=T, sort=F)
}

all_ovlp_hyper_df <- do.call(rbind, all_ovlp_hyper)
all_ovlp_hypo_df <- do.call(rbind, all_ovlp_hypo)
```


```{r}
table(all_ovlp_hyper_df$comparison_wgs, all_ovlp_hyper_df$direction, useNA = "always", dnn=c("Comparison", "direction in WGS within IM-hypermethylated CpG"))
table(all_ovlp_hypo_df$comparison_wgs, all_ovlp_hypo_df$direction, useNA = "always", dnn=c("Comparison", "direction in WGS within IM-hypomethylated CpG"))
```
